company.name: Fleetroot
company.shortDescription: Enabling businesses to optimize and automate the last-mile transportation of people, goods, and services
company.description:
Fleetroot is an All-in-One platform that simplifies transportation processes for businesses. Our cutting-edge technology optimizes logistics, delivery, and transportation operations, allowing companies to streamline processes, reduce costs, and enhance customer satisfaction.

Fleetroot helps transportation businesses quickly manage and monitor their fleets, assign tasks and routes, track resources in real time, and collect and analyze data. Our platform is designed to be user-friendly, scalable, and customizable to meet the unique needs of each transportation business.

Fleetroot empowers logistics and delivery companies to automate their delivery processes while transportation businesses can optimize their daily operations. Our proprietary technology allows seamless team collaboration, improved customer communication, and increased efficiency.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $310,000, or 37.8% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $5,250,000 to $6,126,023, a 1.17x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 59 (-2 over 90 days) and market heat at 57 (-9).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
